course.title: Generative AI — Complete Deep AI Course
course.description: A Generative AI-specific, beginner-to-advanced course with concept-first notes, practical implementations, dedicated tasks, evaluation, responsible AI considerations and a complete learning-platform capstone.
course.curriculumPolicy: Module and lesson counts are determined by the concepts required to learn the subject properly; no fixed cross-AI template is imposed.
learningOutcomes: Work with realistic datasets and AI workflows.
Understand deployment, cost, privacy and safety considerations.

notes.text: Generative models, tokens, context, inference and the difference between generation and retrieval.

Learn generative ai foundations by starting with the problem it solves, then the underlying mental model, then a small implementation, and finally a realistic AI/data workflow. The student should understand both what the technique does and when it should not be used.
Generative AI Foundations is important in modern AI systems because model quality depends on data, evaluation, architecture and operational decisions—not only on choosing a model.
